subject: Travel & Directions
english: Could you tell me the quickest way to the airport at this time of day?

subject: Travel & Directions
english: Is there a route that avoids the heaviest traffic?

subject: Travel & Directions
english: Would it be easier to explain it using landmarks?

subject: Travel & Directions
english: I think I may have taken the wrong turn.
